                '/api/v1/{}/files/{}/{}/{}'
                .format(
                    self.file.path,
                    file.filename,
                    self.file.url,
                    self.file.mimetype,
                    self.file.encoding
                )
            )
        except RequestError as err:
            if err.code == 404:
                raise HTTPException(
                    status_code=404,
                    detail="File not found.",
                    headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
                )

            raise HTTPException(
                status_code=405,
                detail=f"{err.message} with {file.filename} failed.",
                headers={"WWW-Authenticate": "Bearer"}
            )
        return resp

    async def upload_file(self, file, data=None, **kwargs):
        if not self.file:

        await self.http_get(
            '/api/v1/{}/files/{}'.format(
